candidates.claim: sw-core-01 has a read-write SNMP community (mode RW) with no ACL binding, which violates the management policy that communities must be read-only and restricted by an ACL permitting only MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Remove the RW SNMP community on sw-core-01, or change it to read-only and bind it to the SNMP_NMS ACL that permits only 10.10.99.50.
